decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - All external materials to be used in the development shall match in appearance those used on the existing building.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the details of the controlled entry mechanism and door furniture indicated on the submitted plans, further details of this mechanism and the door furniture, including plans at a scale of 1:20, clarifying its use by the ambulant disabled, shall be submitted to and shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the development being commenced.  The details which are subsequently approved shall be implemented as approved.
description: Installation of secure entrance screens to 4 no. blocks of flats nos. 54 - 61, 92 - 99, 143 - 150 and 115 - 122 inclusive.  Upgrading of the footpath to the rear of 54 - 69.
